'''ZEM-63IG''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board [[Darth Marr's flagship]] during a [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|battle]] with the [[Eternal Fleet]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3636 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The droid was destroyed in battle with an [[Alliance Commander|enemy combatant]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skytrooper ZEM-63IG appears as an enemy in Chapter I: The Hunt in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
